frame.note: Sensitivity values are not fitted operating frequencies. Public deadline conversion remains a separate Gate A obligation.

geometry_example.limitations: Illustrative joint profile, not a new guarantee. The 120k/18-product skinning term is source-backed; 256x1089 counts unique lattice vertices; nine products per projection is an explicit incomplete arithmetic assumption. Normal/light work, clipping, other geometry, operand-port limits and stalls are omitted. A product lane is NOT one DSP block.

field_synthetic_example.limitations: Synthetic conjunction: every patch overlaps every changing field. It is NOT asserted to be a ratified simultaneous V1 guarantee. The 22-uop rate is an illustrative assumption, excludes long-op and transport cost, and must be replaced with actual certified programs and the legal joint envelope.
